output.scope_note: The paper is a lattice-gas Monte Carlo study of garnet lattice ion transport, but its only explicit conductivity number is a literature-cited room-temperature-agnostic value for Li6.55Ga0.15La3Zr2O12, so it is in scope only through that quoted value.

records.evidence_location: Section III.B.4 (Tuning lithium stoichiometry to maximise ionic conductivity)
records.notes: Value is quoted from refs 74 and 75 in the paper, not measured here. The material name is given in the sentence immediately before the quote (e.g. Li6.55 Ga0.15 La3 Zr2 O12); the quoted sentence itself does not name it. No measurement temperature or method is stated. The paper's own conductivity results are only reduced conductivities σ' in arbitrary units shown in figures, so they are not recorded.
